looks.label: Water with ripple array and depth blend
looks.technique: Unshaded, no depth draw; ripple texture array with frame count; shallow and deep colour uniforms; depth-texture fade.

looks.label: Banded sky with cloud noise and storm parameter
looks.technique: Five sky band colours plus fog, disc and halo sizes, cloud noise with wind, glow, storm and density uniforms.

looks.label: Per-chunk texture layers with alpha splat
looks.technique: Texture array layers per chunk, chunk layer map, alpha maps blending layers.

looks.label: Colour-coded debuff slots
looks.technique: Dispel-type enum (none, magic, curse, disease, poison) with a colour per type; 48 aura slots; harmful auras from slot 32.

looks.label: Additive weapon trail
looks.technique: Additive ribbon with 30 edges per second, 0.5 s lifetime, tint and gravity.

looks.label: Data-driven spell visual kits
looks.technique: Precast, cast and impact kits per spell; missile speed; shake group by kit.

looks.label: Round portrait mask
looks.technique: Canvas shader that fades alpha outside a round radius on the portrait texture.

originals.name: Dune-storm zone
originals.idea: A desert zone whose sand storm drifts sideways and lowers visibility.
originals.keep: Sideways sand drift and a storm state.
originals.change: Palette, shimmer warning and our own weather odds.

originals.name: Tidal basin
originals.idea: A water zone that switches to an underwater state when the player dips below the surface.
originals.keep: One world-condition enum drives fog and tint.
originals.change: Our underwater palette; no copied grade.

originals.name: Ember channel
originals.idea: A magma liquid used as a hazard channel with crack glow lines.

originals.name: Three-state stance
originals.idea: Unarmed, melee and ranged stances with a shield stance added.
originals.change: Shield stance and our own idle poses.

originals.name: Armour-as-paint
originals.idea: Armour painted into one skin atlas, with a glow channel for tier.
originals.change: Our atlas layout and glow tiers.

originals.name: Trail by weapon family
originals.idea: Short additive ribbon trails whose shape and tint depend on the weapon family.
originals.change: Trail shape and tint per family.

originals.name: Colour-coded debuff slots
originals.idea: Harmful auras shown in a block of slots coloured by type.

originals.name: Round portrait mask
originals.idea: A frame with a round mask on the unit portrait.
